text:
Maya: Heads up :eyes: — seeing a split in GPU charges for project `redwood-atlas-sim` this morning. About 60/40 between `team=atlas-prod` and `team=atlas-workers` in the billing export, but this workload should be 100% atlas-prod.

Rory: Can you paste a few sample rows from the export?

Maya: Sure, copied a tiny sample from the export:```
project_id,resource_label_team,resource_label_owner,cost
redwood-atlas-sim,atlas-prod,infra,1200.00
redwood-atlas-sim,atlas-workers,infra,800.00
```

Maya: Also saw this in the daily charge alert dashboard: https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery?project=billing-prod (filtered to redwood-atlas-sim) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Liam: Probable root cause: last week's autoscaler change introduced a different node label key (`resource_label_owner`), some ephemeral nodes inherit `team=atlas-workers`. Autoscaler template PR 432 changed the node pool labels.

Nadia: Is any of that customer-facing / billable to a customer? Want to flag if it affects chargebacks.

Maya: It's internal infra for model training, not customer billable. But our chargeback pipeline uses `resource_label_team` so the 40% with `atlas-workers` ends up in the unallocated bucket which skews team budgets.

CostBot: Automated alert — unassigned GPU spend > $500 in 24h for project `redwood-atlas-sim`. Ticket: #COST-824 :rotating_light:

Rory: Action items: (1) patch autoscaler template to emit `resource_label_team=atlas-prod` for worker nodes, (2) run a backfill to remap historic rows for the last 30 days, (3) add guardrails to the billing pipeline to reject unknown label keys. I can own the PRs.

Liam: For backfill, use a join against our node metadata mapping. Example SQL snippet:```
-- backfill team label using node metadata mapping
UPDATE `billing_export.gcp_costs` b
SET labels_team = IFNULL(labels_team, m.team)
FROM `billing_metadata.node_labels` m
WHERE b.resource_id = m.resource_id AND DATE(b.usage_start_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY);
```

Maya: Perfect. Rory, can you also add a temporary alert tweak so CostBot doesn't spam the daily channel until we fix?

Rory: Yep — I'll silence the noisy alert threshold for this project for 48h and post the PRs.

Nadia: Please add a short blurb to the monthly budgets doc noting the expected reallocation so budget owners aren't surprised.

Maya: Adding to budgets doc now and will DM owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Rory: Creating follow-up checklist: backfill job, autoscaler patch, alert tweak, postmortem. ETA 24-48h.

Liam: If anyone needs the node-pool template I can paste it here. Otherwise I'll wait for Rory's PR to review.

Maya: We'll lean on Rory + Liam. I'll update finance once backfill is done.

CostBot: Note logged to ticket #COST-824 by CostBot at 1917654500.
